start.speaker: Sorrel
start.text:
She is filthy, and the chalk is down to a stub, and she is looking at you as if you have done something faintly rude.

"He said a rite. He did not say whose."

welcome.speaker: Sorrel
welcome.text:
I did not say thank you. I said he did not tell me whose.

...The list is one shorter. Take that as whatever you like.

name.speaker: Sorrel
name.text: It was. It is not any more, and I have not decided yet whether that is a kindness.
